::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** September 3d [before 1881]  
**From:** “Monthly Packet” 6, Paternoster Row, London, E.C.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

My dear Madam,

I wish I could give you a more agreeable answer, but I am afraid that there is no space available in the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) for your contributions which could hardly find admittance soon enough to answer to your present wishes

I am afraid too that I have too many sketches of travels already on my hands

Yours truly
C M Yonge
